cases.case_label: Polymorphic Alu insertion in SPAST mediating two distinct disease-associated exon deletions
cases.mechanism_detail: Long-range PCR resolved two SPAST deletions involving distinct exons; both had Alu-derived sequence at the breakpoints and both arose on the same founder allele. The authors conclude a single prior Alu retrotransposition event was the shared primary step, after which the inserted Alu mediated one deletion by non-homologous end joining and the other by non-allelic homologous recombination.
cases.quote: Our data suggest that the deletions are best explained by two-step insertion-deletion scenarios for which a single Alu retrotransposition event represents the shared primary step.
